thread:
leah (AP): Received INV-812345 for $31,500 from Vendor-CloudPro. PO-2026-500 attached, but approver routing sent it to EMEA procurement (wrong region). Also vendor billed list price; contract tiered discount should have applied. Auto-match blocked due to approver mismatch and disputed amount. Need routing.
approvals-bot: Invoice 812345 queued. Match flags: approver routing mismatch (PO region != vendor region); billing dispute: tiered discount not applied.
michael (Procurement): @leah can you attach the invoice snippet and the PO meta? Looks like PO-2026-500 is tagged region=NA but vendor profile shows EMEA which triggered auto-routing.
leah (AP): attaching excerpt:
```
Invoice: INV-812345
Amount: 31,500.00 USD
PO: PO-2026-500 (region=NA)
Lines: Reserved capacity 35,000 @ list rate
Discount: 0% applied (should be tiered 10% for spend > 30k)
Note: billed monthly prepaid
```
tom (EngFinance): Contract SOW section 3.4: tiered discounts apply automatically at monthly invoice sum >30k USD -> 10% discount. This invoice crossed the threshold; vendor should have applied 10% (expected net 28,350). Looks like vendor billing bug.
michael (Procurement): Two issues: (1) approver routing mis-tagged because vendor record region=EMEA; I'll update vendor profile to NA to fix routing. (2) For immediate reconciliation, vendor needs to issue credit or provide written attestation that they will honor the 10% and allow Redwood to apply a manual credit. Policy: vendor attestation + procurement exception ok for non-material disputes (<50k) if Director signs.
vendor-cloudpro: Hi all  apologies. Our billing export missed the tiered discount flag and our ERP mapped vendor region incorrectly. We confirm INV-812345 should have applied 10% and will issue credit CN-998 within 48 hours. If Redwood prefers immediate netting, we confirm in writing: "Vendor-CloudPro confirms INV-812345 should be discounted 10% per SOW 3.4 and authorizes Redwood to apply an immediate credit of $3,150."
leah (AP): Vendor attestation received. GL: 6102-Cloud-SaaS; project tag infra-na. AP can apply credit if exception approved.
elaine (Finance Dir): Create procurement exception EXC-14022: "apply vendor credit without PO reissue due to tiered discount billing error + approver routing fix" and route to me. If Procurement confirms vendor profile fix and vendor attestation attached, I'll sign.
approvals-bot: Exception EXC-14022 created, awaiting Elaine (Finance Dir) approval.
michael (Procurement): Vendor profile region updated to NA and PO routing fixed for future invoices. Attestation and proof of update attached to EXC-14022.
approvals-bot: EXC-14022 routed to Elaine. Status: pending signature.
elaine (Finance Dir): Reviewed attachments. Signing EXC-14022. Approving AP to post manual credit $3,150 to INV-812345 and mark reconciliation as "pending vendor CN-998". Procurement: ensure vendor uploads CN-998 within 48 hours.
approvals-bot: EXC-14022 signed by Elaine (Finance Dir). Status: approved.
leah (AP): Applied $3,150 credit to INV-812345, ledger updated (net invoice 28,350). Reconciliation CSV uploaded to EXC-14022. Marked pending CN-998.
vendor-cloudpro: CN-998 uploaded and will show PO-2026-500. Thanks for the quick resolution and sorry for the billing glitch. We'll confirm vendor-side routing fix complete.
michael (Procurement): Confirmed vendor routing fix verified. Closing EXC-14022 when CN-998 is in portal. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
